# cofide_connect_cloud_account (Data Source)

Provides information about a Cofide Connect cloud account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cofide = {
      source  = "cofide/cofide"
      version = "~> 0.9.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "cofide" {}


variable "name" {
  description = "The name of the cloud account."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-cloud-account"
}


data "cofide_connect_cloud_account" "example" {
  name = var.name
}


output "cloud_account_id" {
  description = "The ID of the cloud account."
  value       = data.cofide_connect_cloud_account.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the cloud account.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) The ID of the Cofide organization this cloud account belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `aws` (Attributes) AWS-specific configuration for the cloud account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))
- `cloud_organization_id` (String) The ID of the cloud organization this cloud account belongs to, if any.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of resource creation.
- `id` (String) The ID of the cloud account.
- `last_updated_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last resource update.
- `managed_by_discovery` (Boolean) When true, the existence of this cloud account in Connect is managed by the discovery mechanism.
- `suppressed` (Boolean) When true, discovery is suspended for this account and existing discovered resources are hidden from findings.

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The 12-digit AWS account ID.

- `lambda_discovery_config` (Attributes) Configuration for Lambda function discovery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws--lambda_discovery_config))

### Nested Schema for `aws.agent_core_discovery_config`

Read-Only:

- `audience` (String) Audience value for the initial SPIFFE JWT-based assume role call.
- `discovery_enabled` (Boolean) Whether discovery is enabled for this config.
- `discovery_interval` (String) How frequently discovery runs for this config (a Go duration string, e.g. `1m`, `1h`).
- `last_successful_discovery` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last successful discovery run.
- `regions` (List of String) AWS regions to discover resources in.
- `role_chain` (Attributes List) Ordered chain of IAM roles to assume. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws--agent_core_discovery_config--role_chain))
- `status` (String) The current status of cloud resource discovery (e.g. `DISCOVERING`, `ERROR`).
- `status_last_updated_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last status update.
